sentences: The earth is big and round.
I love the smell of fresh bread.
I drink cold milk from a glass.

We drive to a large farm by the river. Clouds sail in the sky. A brown horse runs in the green field. The sheep eat grass. I sit on the low wall and never want to leave. The cool air smells so good. I could stay here for a month.
The sky is heavy and dark. I hear rain on the glass. I stay warm in the front room. Mum offers me a drink and a piece of bread. Soon, the sun begins to shine and fills the earth with light.
The sheep eats grass in the green field.
The cloud has the shape of a horse.
I heard a loud noise in the yard.
I clean my room early in the day. I count my toys and put them in order. We are proud that the house looks clean now. Then we have fresh greens for lunch and enjoy a good rest. It is a great day.
Our group plays a match at the park. I pass the ball, and our team scores first! The other team is quick, but we are ready. We shout and play with all our power. At the end, we score again and win!
I brush at night to keep my mouth clean.
The huge ship was a great sight to see.
The lady has a kind heart.
I heard a noise in the yard. It was scary, so I went to look. The wind shook the gate, and my little brother cried out. There was no enemy and no fight. Nothing bad occurred, and we were safe.

I heard a soft cry by the back door, so I hurried out. On the floor, I found a lost cat. It was shy, so I reached out and raised it with care. I held it close, and it seemed glad. Mum gave it a warm snack. Doing a kind act made me smile.
My other dog is small.
We play fun games at the party.
I print my name on the paper.

I turn eight today, and it is my party! Daddy puts up eight gold stars. We eat cake with cream and bread with honey. We dance to music and play fun games. Every child gets a small gift. I smile and laugh all day. I am so lucky!

Mummy reads to me each night. Now we are reading a book about a fairy and a giant. The kind fairy uses magic to help the giant. A crowd cheers with joy. I try to guess the happy ending. Then I sleep and dream about magic.
The box is quite heavy to lift.
My daddy reads to me each day.
My toys are all over the floor.

I am going to the shop with Mum. I have some money and a limit on what I can spend. My bag is empty at first. We use a scale to weigh some fruit. I want an extra treat, but I force myself to stop. If I have any doubt, I refer to my list.

On day seven of our trip, we join a big group on a boat. The ocean is clear and blue. I press my hands on the metal bar and see a huge fish swim by. My mouth opens wide in joy. It is the final class event of the year!
My dad told me a funny joke.
We leave for camp early in the day.
I put my books in the right order.

I paint on a big sheet of paper. I make a round shape that is shiny and quite funny. I print my name in the lower right corner. Then I get a smart idea! I turn the paper into a model with a fine point. I share it with Mum, and she says I have good skill. I shall paint more often!

On the pitch, Mr Tan showed us how to play football. We had to learn to pass the ball. The two teams were equal, so it was a fair game. Ben meant to score when the ball moved to him, but he missed. He needs more time to practise. “I’m gonna score next time!” he said.
We shall go to the park after lunch.
My dog does a silly dance for food.
Each of us gets an equal share of the cake.

One day, Mia and her dad went to a local shop in the north. As they enter, they see a tall plant by the door. The price of a pound of apples is good. A kind lady serves them with a smile. Since the line is short, they do not wait long. Dad says they might cross the road to visit one more place.

A tiny mouse lives in the wall by my bed. Each day, I put some bread down and say, “Hello, mouse.” I give a soft knock on the wall and wait. Maybe it will come out to eat. I stay quiet, but my heart beats like a clock!
The race is a major event at camp.
The house is very quiet at night.
A fairy uses magic to help the lost girl.

Mr Lee was our guide on a class trip to the shore. He told us to take care near the wet rocks. The water level was high, so it made sense to stay back. We began our march along the shore and saw a wide range of rocks. Then Mr Lee gave us a silly game to solve. We had to find at least five rocks and make a shape. Each group had to prove that they followed the rules. In the end, Mr Lee granted a small prize to the best team.

Emma wore a fancy dress for the class play. She was a royal lady. She used a soft cover to keep her hat safe. In the play, a judge sat in court and asked her a question. Emma gave a clear reply. A toy plane was also shown as a major part of the play. By the end, Emma was known as the star of the show!
